heading: Frequently asked questions
subtext: Quick answers to the things people ask most often.

items.question: What is AstroPlanet?
items.answer: AstroPlanet is a config-driven website builder that lets you assemble production-ready Astro sites from JSON and theme files without writing boilerplate.

items.question: Do I need to know Astro or React?
items.answer: No. AstroPlanet is built so marketers, designers, and developers can publish pages by editing config files. Astro knowledge is only needed if you want to extend the framework.

items.question: Is dark mode supported out of the box?
items.answer: Yes. Every section is dark-mode-first and adapts automatically to your theme’s CSS custom properties.

items.question: Can I add my own components?
items.answer: Absolutely. Drop a new Astro component into the section library, register its variant in the wrapper, and reference it from any page config.

items.question: How do I deploy my site?
items.answer: Build locally or connect any static host. The output is standard Astro static HTML with zero lock-in.
